# OpenKrillion

> An independent open-source Krillion-inspired daily trivia game. Not affiliated with the original Krillion service.

Canonical: https://openkrillion.com/
Source code (MIT): https://github.com/mgiv/openkrillion-static

## Play
Seven open-answer prompts, a 3-second preview, and 25 seconds per answer. Prepared rarity tiers award 10, 15, 30, 60, 85 or 100 points. Seven answers can total 700 points and 7,000 metres.

Choose Begin Descent, read the category, type an answer, press Enter or Dive, confirm a proposed correction if shown, then continue. After round seven, Surface opens the score report and accepted-answer review.

Daily resets at midnight America/New_York. Practice is separate. Settings, in-progress dives and history are stored only in this browser. There is no account, game server, cross-device sync, or comparison against other players.

## Limits
No generative model, credits, payment flow, themed packs, user login or official affiliation. The public source ships an independently assembled rotating bank of 42 categories and more than 1,400 accepted answers. The entire game runs client-side from static files; no Worker, API or database is required.

These documents are rendered from the same public product configuration used by the website. Changes take effect on deployment. External AI links only prefill a public question and may require a provider account; answers and indexing are not guaranteed.
